_readme: Instagram handles for VENUES and SHOW SERIES (producers/bookers).
Why this file exists: comedian handles are already resolved automatically
— generate-blog-post.js runs lookupInstagramHandles() (LLM web search),
validates each one with a HEAD to instagram.com/{handle}/, and writes it
to the comedian manifest as `instagramHandle`; post-to-instagram.js then
reads it via resolveHandle() and tags the comedian in the feed photo.
Nothing did the equivalent for the rooms and the people booking them, so
the nightly 'Tonight in Houston' post currently tags nobody.
Handles are researched by hand, not generated, because a fabricated tag
is worse than no tag — it publicly @s a stranger. `confidence` records
how each one was established:
owner-confirmed — the site owner confirmed it from their own
knowledge of the scene. Highest confidence.
confirmed  — a live instagram.com/{handle}/ profile URL was returned
by search for this exact venue/series.
unverified — the handle was asserted in prose (an event listing, a
venue site) but no profile URL was seen. Do NOT tag on
these until checked by eye; they are recorded so nobody
re-does the research.
null       — searched, nothing found (see `note`). Leave it null
rather than guessing.
Matching mirrors the other config files: `match` is a case-insensitive
substring of the event's venue name; `title_match` (series) is a
case-insensitive substring of the event title. Both can apply to one
event: tag the room AND the series when both are known. A series entry
with `also_tag_venue: true` says so explicitly — the show account may
be a national brand while the room is the Houston-local audience, and
both are worth reaching.
ORDER MATTERS: take the FIRST match, and keep the list most-specific
first. 'The Riot Comedy Club' is a substring of 'The Riot Comedy Club
— Conroe', so the Conroe entry sits above it — otherwise Conroe shows
get tagged with the Houston account, which is a different room with a
different audience.
Instagram allows 20 user_tags per feed photo. Tagging is not wired up
yet; this file is the data it will read.
Researched 2026-08-14. Handles rot — re-check before a big push.

venues.note: Separate account from @theriothtx. Runs inside GuadalaHARRY's. MUST stay above the Houston Riot entry — its name contains that one as a substring.
205 events — by far the highest-volume room in the feed. Moved from Rudyards to 1925 Washington Ave.
~68K followers — the largest audience of any room in the feed.
Also the home of every open mic in config/open-mics.json.
Do not confuse with @uhdenbar (the UH student bar, also 'The Den').
Hosts Social Comedy Nite. 314 Main St.
~32K followers. Hosts the Thursday Social Comedy Nite.
Home of the East End Comedy Showcase (Thursdays).
Eventbrite ships this room as the bare address '1008 Prairie St'; VENUE_ALIASES in fetch-events.js now normalizes it to the real name. Match on the name, not the address.
The barbershop itself. For comedy nights prefer the series handle below — that's the audience that cares.
Matches both the Upstairs and Downstairs rooms.
Not @avantgardenweddings, which is the events-rental account.
Asserted in prose; only IG location pages surfaced, no profile URL. Check by eye before tagging.
Sugar Land gastropub, hosts free Tuesday comedy. Active on Facebook (/p/Big-Ben-Tavern-100067731071518/); no Instagram account found.

National account, ~1M followers. City accounts exist (@donttellaustin, @donttellphx) but no Houston equivalent was found — the naming pattern is inconsistent, so don't assume @donttellhouston without checking.

series.note: The show's account, and the better of the two tags — but CHECK THE SPELLING before the first tagged post. Owner referred to it as '@Barbershopcomedy'; the Eventbrite listing says '@barbershopcomedyshow'. These are different handles and only one exists. Owner's call: tag the venue (@cutthroatbarbers) alongside it, since the room is Houston-local and the show account is a national brand.

No dedicated account found — the series runs across Notsuoh, Social Beer Garden and Big Ben Tavern and is hosted by Taylor Needham of Play & Improv. Tag the venue instead. Worth asking the host directly whether the show has its own handle.
Confirmed by the site owner 2026-08-15. Not @catdadscomedy, which also exists.

not_researched._note: One event each in the current feed (~11 of 460 total, 2%). Large non-comedy rooms — low tagging value, so the research was stopped here rather than guessed at.
